reasoning_traces.think:
The no-claim scanning system operates as a dual-layered semantic filter: first, a CI gate (GSE) applies regex-based exclusion rules to all content surfaces; second, GSI interprets these exclusions as Bayesian constraints on performance claims. The system enforces a topological exclusion region E ⊂ P, where P is the space of possible performance claims. When content intersects E, it is rejected. This dual enforcement ensures that no valid claim can be made without violating either the syntactic constraints of GSE or the probabilistic bounds of GSI. Failure modes arise when E shrinks or expands due to semantic drift, leading to false positives or negatives. The system’s robustness depends on maintaining consistent boundary conditions between GSE’s regex kernel and GSI’s probabilistic model.
